# Delhi Palace

> Authentic Indian & Hakka (Indo-Chinese) restaurant at 46 Dalhousie St in downtown Brantford, Ontario, Canada. Tandoori specialties, curries, biryanis, momos, Hakka noodles and fresh naan — dine-in, pickup and delivery. Official site: https://thedelhipalace.ca/

## Location & contact
- Address: 46 Dalhousie St, Brantford, ON N3T 2H8, Canada (downtown, near Harmony Square)
- Phone: +1 (519) 304-9661
- Email: delhipalacebrantford@gmail.com
- Hours: open daily (Monday–Sunday), 11:15 am – 10:00 pm
- Google reviews: https://g.page/r/Cf9-KbtubZBLEBM/review

## Cuisine
Indian: butter chicken, kadhai paneer, paneer tikka masala, dal, chana masala, biryani (chicken, lamb, vegetable), tandoori chicken and kebabs, fresh naan, garlic naan and roti from the tandoor, gulab jamun, lassi.
Hakka / Indo-Chinese: chilli chicken, chilli paneer, Hakka noodles, chilli garlic fried rice, Manchurian, steamed momos and dumplings.
Extensive vegetarian sections across appetizers, mains, tandoori and Hakka dishes. Also: lunch thalis and combos (Veg Thali $17, Non-Veg Thali $18), mocktails, lassi, shakes and chai.
